name: Motion
summary: Open source animation library for JavaScript, React and Vue with springs, gestures, layout transitions and scroll-linked effects.
description: A hybrid animation engine that combines JavaScript with native browser APIs for GPU-accelerated animations, with first-class packages for React, JavaScript and Vue (Framer Motion is now Motion; import from motion/react). Batteries include gestures, springs, layout transitions, scroll-linked effects and timelines, alongside 450+ copy-paste examples, 110+ tutorials, the Motion Studio visual editor and an MIT-licensed skill and MCP server for AI agents.
contains: springs, gestures, layout transitions, scroll-linked effects and timelines
hybrid engine: JavaScript plus native browser APIs, 120fps GPU-accelerated
Motion Studio visual editor for keyframes, easing curves and springs
Motion+ paid plan: premium APIs, AI kit, private Discord
